Blocked: the repository tools are unavailable (every list_files/read_file/edit_file/run_command call returns "unknown tool"), so I cannot inspect the codebase, adjust the local parser dependency, or run the focused test.

What I would do once tools work:
- Inspect manifest files to find the declared local parser dependency.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript: check package.json for entries like "parser": "file:./parser" or a workspace reference; ensure the local package exists with a matching name/version, and that workspaces are configured. If only a module file is intended, replace the dependency with a relative import and remove the package dependency. Run npm/yarn/pnpm install and the focused test script.
  • Python: check pyproject.toml/setup.cfg/requirements for a local path (e.g., parser @ file://./parser). Ensure the package folder and pyproject exist; otherwise switch imports to a relative module or vendor the file. Beware name clashes with the removed stdlib parser module; rename the local package to avoid shadowing. Reinstall and run pytest -k <focused test>.
  • Rust: check Cargo.toml for parser = { path = "parser" } and ensure workspace membership and correct crate name. cargo test -p <crate> --test <focused>.
  • Go: check go.mod for a replace directive to ./parser; ensure module path matches and run go test ./... focusing the specific package.
- Make the smallest change (fix path/name/workspace config) and rerun only the focused test.
